data.name: Vumatel
data.market_focus: Suburban, township (via Vuma Reach & Vuma Key products)
data.notes: Largest FNO by homes passed (~32% market share). Part of MAZIV group (with DFA). Aggressively targeting middle-to-lower income segments. Key direct competitor in township aerial deployment.

data.name: Openserve
data.notes: Telkom's wholesale division. Second-largest FNO. Strong connectivity ratios. Less township-focused than Vumatel.

data.name: Link Africa
data.notes: Top 8 ISPA-rated FNO. Focuses on large-scale metro and long-haul projects. Competes in bulk infrastructure contracts.

data.name: Dark Fibre Africa (DFA)
data.notes: Part of MAZIV group. Critical backbone infrastructure provider. Not a direct last-mile aerial competitor but relevant to large municipal contracts.

data.name: Frogfoot Networks
data.notes: Multi-province FNO with strong ISP partnerships. Expanding into underserved areas.

data.name: Octotel
data.notes: Top-rated in ISPA surveys. Strong reliability reputation. Western Cape focused â€” limited national township footprint.

data.name: Net Nine Nine
data.homes_passed: Growing â€” publicly stated aggressive expansion
data.notes: Closest strategic competitor to Vcom. Explicitly targets townships and villages. Uses affordable prepaid and daily-rate models.

data.name: Evotel
data.notes: ISPA highly-rated. Known for strong regional and secondary-city coverage. Competing for non-metropolitan network buildout contracts.

data.name: Lightstruck
data.notes: Emerging FNO specifically positioned in underserved markets. Direct competitor in township aerial fibre segment.

data.name: Fibertime
data.notes: Specialist township FNO. Daily-rate internet model designed for low-income households. Strong differentiation on affordability. Very close strategic competitor to Vcom.
